I notice that the bottom region has a white triangle on the left side (rows 39-43). This white triangle was created by stamping white from the LEFT position earlier. To fill the bottom region with purple, I need to stamp purple from the LEFT position to overwrite the white triangle.
Let me try:
1. Move frame to LEFT position (currently at BELOW, so DOWN once: BELOW→LEFT)
2. Select purple (click on purple)
3. Press SPACE to stamp purple from LEFT
But wait, clicking on purple will also stamp purple on the top region, changing it from white to purple. So I need to click on white again after stamping purple from LEFT.
Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The stamp from the color selector (clicking on white/purple) only affects the top region. The stamp from SPACE affects the region based on the current frame position. So:
- Clicking on white: Top region becomes white
- Clicking on purple: Top region becomes purple
- Pressing SPACE from BELOW with purple selected: Bottom region gets purple stamp from bottom
- Pressing SPACE from LEFT with purple selected: Bottom region gets purple stamp from left
- Pressing SPACE from RIGHT with purple selected: Bottom region gets purple stamp from right
So to fill the bottom region with purple, I need to stamp purple from BELOW, LEFT, and RIGHT positions. But the problem is that the bottom region already has purple on rows 34-38, and only rows 39-43 have the white triangle on the left.
Let me try stamping purple from LEFT position to fill the white triangle with purple.
